meta.name: subagent-execution
meta.description: Execute implementation plans using subagents. Three modes: single task, batch (sequential), parallel. Two-stage review for every task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将复杂计划拆解为子任务并自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down complex plans into subtasks and execute them automatically

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为每个任务启动一个全新的子代理来执行。每个任务都经过规范审查和代码质量审查两轮检查，确保结果可靠。
howto.when: 当你有一个实现计划（如来自 structured-brainstorming 技能），需要执行单个任务、按顺序执行多个任务或并行执行独立任务时触发。

say.text: 执行计划中的第一个任务。
say.note: Claude 会启动子代理实现该任务，并自动进行两轮审查。

say.text: 按顺序执行计划中的所有任务。
say.note: Claude 会逐个任务执行，每个任务完成后才进入下一个。

say.text: 并行执行任务2和任务3，它们不依赖彼此。
say.note: Claude 会同时启动两个子代理，各自独立执行并审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude spawns a fresh subagent for each task. Every task goes through two-stage review: spec compliance and code quality, ensuring reliable results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have an implementation plan (e.g., from structured-brainstorming skill) and need to execute a single task, sequential tasks, or parallel independent tasks.

say_en.text: Execute the first task in the plan.
Execute all tasks in the plan sequentially.
say_en.note: Claude processes tasks one by one, completing each before moving to the next.

say_en.text: Execute task 2 and task 3 in parallel; they are independent.
